title: Brazil- Heavy, but Sweet
summary:
Brazil- Heavy, but Sweet
Brazil is South America's largest nation occupying more than half of the continent with its largest population of 185 million. Brazil, the tenth largest energy consumer in the world and the third largest in the Western Hemisphere after the Unites States and Canada, is undergoing rapid development with a growing population: a prescription for greater energy consumption. The following chart compares Brazil's oil production and consumption with oil reserves, which are now second in South America after Venezuela.

children.summary: Rapidly Increasing Although Brazil has exhibited significant overall economic progress averaging 4.5% since 1981, growth has been marked by fits and starts with contractions occurring regularly followed by spurts of rapid growth. The latest retreat occurred in 2003 when the economy faltered with negative growth of 0.2%, but rapidly recouped in 2004 with growth of 5.1%.
